name: Dataverse
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Metaverse data platform Dataverse tweeted that it has detected hackers attacking the GEO BSC contract, and reminded users not to buy GEO in BSC, any code purchased on BNB Chian from October 19th to 22nd UTC Coins are invalid. It may be caused by the "allow unlimited minting" vulnerability in the minting function of BGEO (Binance GeoDB Coin).
